notes.title: Pizza Connection 1 now on MAC & LINUX
notes.content:
Hey Pizza Fans!

We are proud to announce that Pizza Connection 1 is now also availabe on MAC and LINUX on Steam!
So everyone who already has the game, can now play it on his Mac or Linux device for free and spread the pizza connection addiction.

Enjoy and have fun!
